title: Irish Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Irish stew made with tender beef, potatoes, and vegetables. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef on all sides, then remove from pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onions and garlic until softened.
Add the carrots, potatoes, and flour to the pot, stirring to combine.
Gradually add in the beef broth, whisking to avoid lumps.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1 hour.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
